metadata_rejections: Reject nonempty Fragment; names/genes containing fragment, fusion, readthrough, read-through or pabpn1. Require BCL2L2 gene annotation (case insensitive token or BCL2L2- prefix). These are audit flags, not proof of orthology.
alignment_tie_policy: Use first highest-scoring global PairwiseAligner alignment in installed Biopython 1.88; set epsilon=1e-6; record optimal alignment count and coordinates. Do not choose alignments using coverage or downstream model results.
core_projection: Reference positions 1-164 only. Subject insertions at reference boundaries 0 through 163 are retained lowercase. Insertions at boundary 164 or later and all later residues are outside the selected core and excluded. Deletions are '-'. No terminal insertion may spill into peptide chain.
identity: Number of equal, nongap match-column amino acids / 164; gap-gap does not count as a match; insertions are excluded from the denominator.
coverage: Number of nongap core match columns / 164.
selection_order: inherited coverage and core identity filters
best priority per identical core match-column row
farthest_first: If over cap, start with query and repeatedly select the candidate with the smallest maximum match-column identity to all already selected rows, accession ascending on ties. With no cap needed, use priority order.
greedy_clusters: Query first, then final homolog selection order; assign to first existing representative with identity >=0.80, otherwise create a cluster. Report query-inclusive primary and homolog-only diagnostic values.
neff: For query-inclusive rows, sum_i 1 / number_of_j_with_identity(i,j)>=0.80 including self. Also report homolog-only diagnostic value. Identity and >= threshold as above. Gap filtering or alternative Neff definitions are not selected after results.
readiness_denominators: Primary clusters, Neff and per-column nongap fractions include query plus selected homologs; unique nonquery row count excludes query. Homolog-only values are diagnostics and never substitute failed primary values.
complex_a3m: First line #164,23 TAB 1,1; query concatenates unchanged receptor and parent peptide. Separate unpaired receptor block (query + homolog rows padded with 23 gaps), and peptide-only query padded with 164 gaps. No nonquery peptide homologs or inferred biological pairing.
